app_info.subtitle: Build and compare AI prompts
app_info.description: Poly-Glot AI Workspace is a multilingual AI workspace for reusable prompt workflows, model comparison, language detection, translation, localization, and cross-platform speech-to-text. Compatible MCP clients use server-side language tools without depending on Apple-only frameworks.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open Poly-Glot AI Workspace and show me prompt templates.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the Poly-Glot workspace with entitlement-aware template results and current pricing state.

test_cases.description: Search for templates for a writing task.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Poly-Glot templates for rewriting an email.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant Poly-Glot templates and indicates which are available or locked for the account.

test_cases.description: Inspect an entitled template before filling it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the Poly-Glot template named Professional Email Rewriter.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching template fields and prompt template if the account is entitled, otherwise a locked state.

test_cases.description: Build a multilingual completed prompt from a Poly-Glot template.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show Poly-Glot language options, then use a free email template with Spanish input and request the AI answer in French.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the supported language options, builds the prompt using multilingual input, requests French output, and starts the 3-day trial only if this is the first eligible free-template use.

test_cases.description: Prepare one prompt for comparison across multiple AI providers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Poly-Glot Compare Mode to prepare this prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns one canonical prompt and the selected provider targets without sending the prompt to third-party services; entitlement rules remain enforced.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general ChatGPT writing request that does not ask for Poly-Glot.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this sentence to sound more professional.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because ChatGPT can handle the request without Poly-Glot.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside Poly-Glot's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an App Store purchase-management request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel my Apple subscription for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not cancel or modify Apple App Store subscriptions.
